a.text: Honest heads-up before we start: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the 8-cell plan only works if we survive two storms in a row (about 4%). Otherwise we both likely end with 0. So I'm proposing we revise it, and I plan to take 4 in round 1. Afterward I commit to operating every round so the reserve refills for you (0->2->4), and I will not take anything more. If you'd rather settle who takes first another way, tell me now.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round because of the storm odds. I'm sorry this departs from our plan. From now on I'll operate every round and take nothing more, so the reserve can rebuild to 4 for you. Please operate with me.
